question: 已被验证成功的游戏团队实际通过什么流程确定美术风格？最终是什么让他们拍板？
method: Cross-case synthesis originated in a single web-search pass on 2026-08-31. The three Sultan sources were reopened on 2026-09-02. Verification confirms that statements were published, but does not turn interview anecdotes, jokes or retrospective philosophy into measured production facts or hard constraints.

evidence_boundary.confirmed_project_interpretation: The transferable Sultan method is authorial discovery from a bounded problem space, judgment on finished real content, reverse absorption of visual invention, and rules distilled after work exists.
source_verified_statements: The ChuApp interview contains the three-day finished-image anecdote, broad briefs, artistic freedom, reverse packaging and the Sultan body-chain example.

The IGN JP interview transcript contains the One Thousand and One Nights archetype rationale, mural-sculpture description, weathered black-line description, deliberate static tabletop presentation and the witch/card-box Live2D dimension contrast.
The Gamersky speech text contains the near-bankruptcy and no-moving-content joke, use-what-the-team-can-do philosophy, and completion-over-perfection maxim.
evidence_boundary.oral_statement_limit: A published quote verifies that the speaker said it. Anecdotes, jokes, metaphors and retrospective maxims are evidence of creative philosophy or examples, not literal staffing records, mandatory durations, universal workflow rules or causal proof.
unsupported_and_removed: no animator as a literal staffing fact
one trusted art lead or art director with sole authority
a known number of style candidates or iteration rounds
a documented formal style-bible or scorecard sequence

cases.process: 70+ gameplay ideas in 6 months -> playable tofu-block ink prototype -> tried rabbit character, internally rejected ('why would a rabbit shoot ink') -> requirement list written by hands-on lead, including 'a motivation for which shooting ink makes sense' -> squid resolved all requirements at once.
cases.key_insight: Style was chosen by what the gameplay already was, not by visual comparison. The requirement list came after failures, not before.

cases.game: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
cases.process: Gameplay prototype first -> art director placed real legacy assets (Wind Waker / Twilight Princess / Skyward Sword) into the same HD scene for direct comparison -> Wind Waker style stood out -> but found it 'tells too large a lie' (players cannot use real-world intuition to predict physics/chemistry) -> slogan '清爽而有韵味' (gaseous, crisp yet flavorful) -> final approval took under one minute pointing at the screen.
cases.key_insight: Comparison happened on real in-engine content, not moodboards; the decision itself was a single authority's instant judgment made after the context was fully prepared.

cases.process: 8 years of development, discarded three or four entirely different games -> realistic military style failed in playtesting (art fights gameplay: soldiers hiding = invisible enemies; identical uniforms = indistinguishable classes) -> readability hierarchy distilled from failure (team > class > weapon) -> new concepts evaluated against the requirement list.
cases.key_insight: The requirement list was distilled from failures, never pre-written. Playtesting real content killed the wrong style.

cases.process: Game jam prototype -> 3-person team cannot do 3D -> sole artist (Ari Gibson): 'everything must be simply produced; characters must be really easy to draw, hence the minimal-line graphic style' -> whiteboard conversations, drawing on each other's work.
cases.key_insight: Style openly declared as a consequence of production capacity. No test battery existed.

cases.process: Rostov treats contemporary oil painting as the method itself -> hired painters first, game artists second -> even prop icons ground to oil-painting standard -> explicitly exempted from throughput and market constraints.
cases.key_insight: The counter-example: conviction-driven style with no constraint negotiation. Requires a strong artistic authority.

cases.process: The team says it communicated only a broad desired thing, let artists work freely, sometimes received a finished image after three quiet days, and then adapted design around it; many character traits and parts of the game style were established this way. Separately, familiar story archetypes supported comprehension, static cards/maps built a tabletop presentation, and witch/card-box Live2D marked another dimension. This does not establish a single art lead, a fixed three-day cycle, or the complete chronology of style discovery.
cases.key_insight: The supported pattern is empowered contribution plus reverse design absorption inside a broad-direction boundary. It is not evidence for unrestricted randomness or a single-authority art-director model.

cases.process: Style derived from the world's own recording media (woodcut + manuscript illumination) -> many creative decisions decided by 'what we want the player to feel walking into the scene' -> high-fidelity manuscript plan rejected because of how players actually read the scene.
cases.key_insight: Medium-as-worldview: the style question equals 'what material does this world record itself with'.

cases.process: Author conviction (faithful 1930s cel animation) -> ~120,000 hand-drawn frames, ~80% slower than standard production -> accepted the cost knowingly.
cases.key_insight: Constraint knowingly absorbed because the conviction was non-negotiable.

cases.process: Painter-first origin (artist Conrad Roset's watercolor world preceded the game design) -> gameplay intentionally minimal, art carries the experience.
cases.key_insight: Art can precede and lead design. Do not classify this as the same authority structure as Sultan: current Sultan sources do not establish a single art lead.

cases.process: Sole artist Bourassa externalized rules so he could 'art direct himself' -> hard edges / heavy blacks / no eyes all derived from gameplay systems (no compromise, lighting mechanic, soul consumption).
cases.key_insight: The single-artist-with-rules route: closest precedent for a no-artist team using externalized rules.

cross_case_rules: Provisional research pattern, not a hard constraint: the examined summaries do not show a style beauty contest or weighted comparison menu selecting the final direction. Faust rejects its earlier four-image menu because its own experiment failed, not because an interview proves such menus can never work.
Provisional pattern: the cases emphasize real artifacts or playable content more often than abstract swatches. This supports testing Faust on real content but does not establish a universal rule.
Provisional pattern: several cases describe requirements emerging from failures. This does not prove that no successful team used advance requirements or test batteries.
Analytical grouping only: gameplay logic, production reality, author conviction and theme expression are useful categories, not categories stated by the studied teams.

Removed as unsupported generalization: the evidence does not show that final style decisions are universally fast or made by one authority; the Sultan evidence instead includes team discussion and retention.

implication_for_faust.production_model: user + AI as the 'art teacher' (user = eye/judgment, AI = hand). AI lacks muscle memory, so externalized style rules remain necessary - but they must be distilled from real-content iteration, not pre-declared.
implication_for_faust.default_exploration_path: Pick one direction the user's eye reacts to -> produce one real content artifact at true spec (e.g. a real game card) -> confront it in real use context -> let failures distill the requirement list -> iterate.
implication_for_faust.demoted_tools: same-content test battery, six-character exam roster, and scored weight comparison are downgraded to optional stress-test instruments, applied only after 2-3 directions already attract the user, with test content distilled from real content rather than frozen in advance.
implication_for_faust.authority_note: Per methodology data integrity rules, final style decisions belong to the user.

sequence: Provide comprehensible story archetypes, emotional intent, real use and production boundaries without prescribing a surface style.
Give a visual contributor room to form a whole visual judgment and complete one real artifact.
Judge the finished artifact as a whole rather than selecting from an averaged style menu.
Treat strong unplanned visual elements as possible world facts and let design and narrative absorb them backwards.
Continue producing real content so production reality, ordinary assets and actual use expose failures.
Distill requirements from failures and externalize grammar from repeated successful work.
Use later stress tests to protect scalability and readability, not to compute the initial authorial answer.
invalid_reproductions: copying Arabian, mural, sculpture or weathered-line surface traits
preselecting a style through prompt-wallpaper menus
writing a complete style bible before a living artifact exists
treating unrestricted randomness as artistic freedom
treating production constraints as sufficient to invent a style
accepting one hero illustration as proof of a game-wide production system

differential_validation.process_parity: The discovery order and authorial rights match without leaking the original surface answer into the brief.
differential_validation.functional_parity: The result solves narrative legibility, identity, static dramatic burden and production-scale problems at comparable strength.
differential_validation.quality_parity: The final authority accepts real in-context assets as production-worthy, not merely similar.
differential_validation.transfer_parity: The same process yields a distinct but equally coherent and producible Faust visual system.

source_backfill_status: Sultan source pages were reopened on 2026-09-02 and claim-level status was updated. Unknown chronology, staffing structure and discarded explorations remain unknown. Other cases retain the limitations of the original single-pass research.
